name: Sakanoue no Korenori
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 31); Porter’s note gives the dates as: 10th century.

poems.title: Surely the morning moon, I thought
poems.author: Sakanoue no Korenori
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 31
poems.text:
Surely the morning moon, I thought,
Has bathed the hill in light;
But, no; I see it is the snow
That, falling in the night,
Has made Yoshino white.
